label: Make skill/agent header validation a real build task; close the test-never-runs defect
summary: Wired the skill-header guard's new --all whole-tree mode into the root `lint` target (check-skill-headers + check-skill-headers-test nx targets), fixed the fail-open CLI detection, the leaked scratch dir, and the BOM/blank-line frontmatter false negative, and gave the checker's test a real runner. Also fixed the out-of-scope sox-ingest `<source>` description defect the whole-tree gate surfaces.

changes.kind: --all whole-tree mode (git ls-files), checkSourcePurity delegates to renderer stripFrontmatter (shared detector), scratch-dir cleanup via process.on('exit'), fail-closed entrypoint detection via fileURLToPath === path.resolve
pass stripFrontmatter to checkSourcePurity, add BOM/leading-blank + bare-rule coverage, document the check-skill-headers-test runner
add check-skill-headers + check-skill-headers-test nx targets (dependsOn host-registry build); lint dependsOn both
OUT-OF-SCOPE unblock: backtick the `<source>` placeholder in the description so skillcheck no longer reads XML markup (backlog d6f9b48f)

tests.command: node tools/check-skill-frontmatter.test.mjs  (also via nx run sox-ecosystem:check-skill-headers-test)

lint.note: eslint tools/check-skill-frontmatter.mjs tools/check-skill-frontmatter.test.mjs exits 0; root nx lint (with the new check-skill-headers + check-skill-headers-test deps) runs green.

build.note: No TS compilation for the .mjs tools; host-registry built via the targets' dependsOn. `node tools/check-skill-frontmatter.mjs --all` = 14/14 passed.

issues: sox-ingest extension.json description contained `<source>` XML-tag markup — surfaced by the new whole-tree gate; fixed in commit 923b5554 (filed + resolved backlog d6f9b48f).

CI gap (out of scope, reported): wiring check-skill-headers into lint means `nx affected -t lint` (and CI's lint step) now runs `uvx skillcheck`; GitHub's ubuntu-latest runner image does not preinstall uv/uvx, so CI needs a uv install step (edits .github/workflows/*.yml, out of file scope) or the check will fail-closed on CI.
handoff_notes: checkSourcePurity(content, file, strip) now REQUIRES the renderer's stripFrontmatter as its third argument — any new caller must pass it (the test + main() do).

The whole-tree --all mode is render-then-lint (renders each skill header from extension.json, then runs `uvx skillcheck` over the rendered output) — a raw sweep would fail every prose-only source SKILL.md.
extensions/skills/sox-ingest/extension.json still carries an UNCOMMITTED version-field removal by a concurrent agent; my description fix (923b5554) deliberately did NOT sweep it.
